tasks.title: Public API: GET /api/v1/docs answers the API reference page, not the docs list
tasks.notes:
Where: REST /api/v1/docs
Steps to reproduce:
1. curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <workspace key>' <base>/api/v1/docs
Expected: JSON { docs: [...] }
Actual: 200 text/html, the Scalar API reference. The list route collides with the reference page path, so no integration can list docs and a find-or-create re-creates every doc.
Fix idea: move the reference to /api/v1/reference (keep a redirect for browsers that send Accept: text/html).

tasks.title: Chat shows agent posts as 'API key "Builder agent key"' instead of the agent's name
tasks.notes:
Where: chat, any channel
Steps to reproduce:
1. Create an agent with POST /api/v1/agents (it returns an agent key).
2. POST /api/v1/chat/channels/{id}/messages with that key.
3. Open the channel in the web app.
Expected: author Builder, with an agent badge (docs: 'An agent key posts as its agent').
Actual: author type agent but the name is 'API key "Builder agent key"'. A workspace key post shows as a member named 'API key "Org setup script"' with initials AK.

tasks.title: Feature: agents as real team members (not only mail inboxes)
tasks.notes:
Where: Agents page, Settings Team, chat, tasks
Today an agent is a mail inbox: it needs a mailbox on a domain (409 'Add a domain first' without one), it does not appear in People or Settings Team, has no title, avatar or bio on screen (the description is stored but the Agents page shows only the address), and the Free plan stops at 3 agent inboxes (403 plan_limit), so a team of six AI agents cannot be created.
Steps to reproduce: run scripts/dogfood/org-setup.ts with scripts/dogfood/example-org.json: agents 4 to 6 fail with plan_limit.
Ask: an agent member type with name, title, bio, avatar and its own scoped key, listed with people, assignable and mentionable everywhere, with the mailbox optional. Count agent members separately from agent inboxes on Free.

tasks.title: Members have no title or bio, and an invite cannot carry one
tasks.notes:
Where: Settings Team, invites
Steps to reproduce:
1. Settings, Team: there is no field for a job title or a short bio.
2. POST /api/team/invites accepts only email, role and mailboxIds.
Also: the invite role is admin or member only. A founder or board chair cannot be invited as Owner; ownership moves only by transfer after they join.
Workaround in the dogfood org: a Team directory doc.

tasks.title: Key results that count down show '10 of 0' and 0 percent
tasks.notes:
Where: Goals
Steps to reproduce:
1. Create a goal with a number key result start 10, target 0, current 10 (for example 'Open high severity bugs').
2. Open Goals.
Expected: 0 percent with 'lower is better' handling, and progress as the count falls.
Actual: '10 of 0' and 0 percent; lowering current does not read as progress.

tasks.title: Meetings cannot repeat, and times show without a time zone
tasks.notes:
Where: Meetings
Steps to reproduce:
1. POST /api/v1/meetings has no recurrence field, so a weekly meeting is one meeting (the dogfood org uses a repeating prep task as a workaround).
2. With the workspace on Australia/Sydney, schedule Monday 10:00 Sydney and open Meetings in a browser on UTC.
Actual: 'Sun, 25 Oct, 11:00 pm' with no zone label.
Expected: weekly or other repeats, and a zone label (or the workspace zone) on every time.

tasks.title: Public API gaps a real org setup hits
tasks.notes:
No /api/v1 route for: creating a workspace, minting the first key, inviting or listing members, updating a channel's topic or archiving it, pinning a message, creating a template, or deleting a doc. The org setup script has to sign in with a password and use the app routes for these.
Steps to reproduce: read /api/v1/openapi.json; search for members, invites, pins, PATCH chat/channels, POST templates.

tasks.title: Chat has no pinned messages
tasks.notes:
Where: chat
Steps to reproduce: open any channel and the message menu: there is no Pin, and no pinned list in the channel header.
Why it matters: every channel's welcome and rules message scrolls away. Workaround today: the channel topic carries the purpose.

tasks.title: Templates: no doc templates, and no template from scratch
tasks.notes:
Where: Templates
Steps to reproduce: Templates offers only project and task templates, and saving one needs an existing project or task (POST /api/templates with fromTaskId).
A release note or a bug report wants a doc template; today it is a task whose notes hold the outline.

tasks.title: Phone (390 px): tasks open as a board with columns cut off; goals and chat cramped
tasks.notes:
Where: Tasks, Goals, Chat at 390 px
Steps to reproduce: open each on a phone width.
Actual: Tasks shows the board with the second column cut off (list view would suit a phone); goal key result names wrap to four lines in a narrow column; the chat composer shows keyboard hints (Enter, Shift Enter) and the sample ref OPS-12, which is not a project in this workspace.

tasks.title: New projects get the email status 'Waiting on reply' by default
tasks.notes:
Where: Tasks, any new project
Steps to reproduce: POST /api/v1/projects with only a name; its statuses include 'Waiting on reply'. A software or launch project wants To do, In progress, In review, Done.

tasks.title: Sign up makes an extra empty workspace, and a new sign in returns to it
tasks.notes:
Steps to reproduce:
1. Sign up: a '<Name>'s workspace' is created.
2. Create a second workspace and switch to it.
3. Sign in again on another device: the session opens the first workspace, not the last one used.

tasks.title: Docs list preview repeats the title and runs headings into the body
tasks.notes:
Where: Docs
Steps to reproduce: create a doc from text starting '# Brand' then a bullet list; the list preview reads 'Brand Brand Primary colour #0071E3, text...'. Expected: the first body line only, with spacing between blocks.

tasks.title: Settings Team leads with the single sign on card; agents not shown with seats
tasks.notes:
Where: Settings, Team
Steps to reproduce: open it with one member. The 'Require single sign on' card sits above the member list, and seats read 1 of 3 with no mention of the agents on the team.

tasks.title: Sidebar: Mail and Team inbox side by side, and more than 20 items
tasks.notes:
Where: sidebar, desktop
Two inbox entries with similar names, and over 20 items before Settings. Group them (Work, Mail, Admin) or let a workspace hide what it does not use.

tasks.title: Copy: 'Video isn't switched on for this Multies yet'
tasks.notes:
Where: Meetings, with video off
The product name is used as a noun for an instance. Suggest: 'Video calls aren't switched on for this workspace yet.'

tasks.title: Local default support address is the old brand (support@mymail.au)
tasks.notes:
Where: /api/config on the node entry when SUPPORT_EMAIL is unset
Steps to reproduce: start the local server and GET /api/config: supportEmail is support@mymail.au.

tasks.title: Inbound: route support@ and security@ on the company domain into the workspace shared inbox
tasks.notes:
Owner: the builder (Cloudflare and Email Routing).
The dogfood workspace needs its domain added and verified, a shared mailbox (support@, security@) and the inbound route pointing that domain at this workspace. Until then customer and security mail does not reach the team's inbox.
